en.s: The first Battle of Lechfeld (the first Battle of Augsburg in Hungarian historiography), fought on 12 June 910, was an important victory by a Hungarian army over the combined forces of East Francia and Swabia (Alamannia) under the nominal command of Louis the Child. Located approximately 25 km (15.53 mi) south of Augsburg, the Lechfeld is the floodplain that lies along the river Lech.

zh.s: 第一次莱希费尔德战役（匈牙利史学中称第一次奥格斯堡战役）于910年6月12日发生，是匈牙利军队战胜东法兰克和施瓦本（阿勒曼尼亚）联军的一场重要胜利。联军名义上由路易四世统帅。莱希费尔德位于奥格斯堡以南约25公里，是沿莱希河延伸的泛滥平原。

en.t: Constantine IX Monomachos is crowned Byzantine emperor
en.s: Constantine IX Monomachos was crowned Byzantine emperor on June 12, 1042, the day after his marriage to Empress Zoë Porphyrogenita. He shared rule with Zoë and her sister Theodora.

zh.t: 君士坦丁九世加冕为拜占庭皇帝
zh.s: 1042年6月12日，君士坦丁九世在与女皇佐伊结婚的次日加冕为拜占庭皇帝。此后，他与佐伊及她的妹妹狄奥多拉共同统治。

en.s: The Peasants' Revolt, also named Wat Tyler's Rebellion or the Great Uprising, was a major uprising across large parts of England in 1381. The revolt had various causes, including the socio-economic and political tensions generated by the Black Death in the 1340s, the high taxes resulting from the conflict with France during the Hundred Years' War, and instability within the local leadership of London.
en.n: Peasants' Revolt: In England, rebels assemble at Blackheath, just outside London.

zh.s: 农民起义又称瓦特·泰勒起义或大起义，是1381年席卷英格兰广大地区的一场重大起义。起义有多种原因，包括1340年代黑死病引发的社会经济和政治紧张局势、百年战争期间对法战争造成的高额税负，以及伦敦地方领导层的不稳定。
zh.n: 农民起义：英格兰起义者聚集在伦敦城外的布莱克希思。

en.t: Paris mob begins massacring Armagnac prisoners and supporters
en.s: On June 12, 1418, a false alarm that an Armagnac army was approaching Paris helped set off mob violence in the city, then controlled by the Burgundian faction. Crowds attacked people suspected of supporting the Armagnacs and stormed prisons. Bernard VII, Count of Armagnac, was among those killed. The massacres continued into June 13.
en.n: The Paris massacres began on June 12 and continued into June 13; the Burgundian takeover of the city had happened on May 29.

zh.t: 巴黎民众开始屠杀阿马尼亚克派囚犯和支持者
zh.s: 1418年6月12日，巴黎传出阿马尼亚克派军队即将攻城的假警报，引发民众暴动。当时巴黎由勃艮第派控制。人群袭击被怀疑支持阿马尼亚克派的人，还冲进监狱杀害囚犯。死者包括阿马尼亚克伯爵贝尔纳七世。杀戮延续到6月13日。
zh.n: 这场屠杀从6月12日持续到13日；勃艮第派此前已于5月29日控制巴黎。

en.s: The Battle of Jargeau took place on 11–12 June 1429. It was part of the Loire Campaign during the Hundred Years' War, where the forces of Charles VII of France successfully recaptured much of the region, following their victory at the Siege of Orléans. The battle ended in victory for Charles VII and is notable as Joan of Arc's first offensive battle.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 雅尔若战役发生于1429年6月11日至12日，是百年战争期间卢瓦尔河战役的一部分。奥尔良围城战获胜后，法国国王查理七世的军队成功收复了该地区大部分领土。雅尔若战役以查理七世获胜告终，也是圣女贞德首次主动发起进攻的战斗。
zh.n: 本条记录的是来源资料框所列事件的结束日期。

en.t: Gustav I orders townspeople to move to Helsinki
en.s: On June 12, 1550, King Gustav I of Sweden ordered townspeople from Rauma, Ulvila, Ekenäs and Porvoo to move to the new town of Helsinki. The date later became Helsinki’s official birthday. The city’s initial establishment order had been issued on February 1 that year.
en.n: June 12 marks the relocation order used for Helsinki’s founding anniversary; Finland was then part of Sweden.

zh.t: 古斯塔夫一世下令市民迁往赫尔辛基
zh.s: 1550年6月12日，瑞典国王古斯塔夫一世下令，让拉乌马、乌尔维拉、埃克内斯和波尔沃的市民迁往新城赫尔辛基。赫尔辛基后来将这一天定为建城纪念日。最初的建城命令已于当年2月1日发布。
zh.n: 6月12日是迁居命令的日期，后来被用作赫尔辛基建城纪念日；当时芬兰属于瑞典。

en.s: The Battle of Okehazama (桶狭間の戦い, Okehazama-no-tatakai) took place on 12 June 1560 in Owari Province, in today's Aichi Prefecture. In this battle, the heavily outnumbered Oda clan troops, commanded by Oda Nobunaga, defeated Imagawa Yoshimoto and established Oda as one of the front-running warlords in the Sengoku period.

zh.s: 桶狭间之战（日语：桶狭間の戦い，Okehazama-no-tatakai）于1560年6月12日在尾张国（今爱知县）发生。织田信长率领人数远少于对手的织田军击败今川义元，使织田信长成为战国时代最有影响力的大名之一。

en.s: The Parliament of England was the legislature of the Kingdom of England from the 13th century until 1707 when it was replaced by the Parliament of Great Britain as a result of the Treaty of Union 1707 which merged the parliament with the Parliament of Scotland. Parliament evolved from the great council of bishops and peers that advised the English monarch.
en.n: The Westminster Assembly is convened by the Parliament of England, without the assent of Charles I, in order to restructure the Church of England.

zh.t: 英格兰议会下令召集威斯敏斯特会议
zh.s: 英格兰议会是英格兰王国的立法机关，从13世纪延续至1707年，之后因《1707年联合法案》与苏格兰议会合并，由大不列颠议会取代。议会由向英格兰君主提供建议的主教和贵族大议会逐步演变而来。
zh.n: 1643年6月12日，英格兰议会颁布法令，召集威斯敏斯特会议；会议首次开会是在7月1日。此处沿用原始法令所载当时英格兰历法日期，未换算为回推公历。

en.s: The Battle of Tipton Green was an indecisive engagement fought during the First English Civil War in the area of Tipton Green, about one mile from Dudley Castle on 12 June 1644. The battle occurred when Royalist troops arrived from Worcester to break the Earl of Denbigh's siege of the castle. The battle itself was indecisive, as both sides withdrew from conflict.

zh.s: 蒂普顿格林战役发生于1644年6月12日，是第一次英国内战期间一场未分胜负的战斗，地点在蒂普顿格林一带，距达德利城堡约一英里。王党军队从伍斯特赶来，试图解救被丹比伯爵围困的城堡，因此双方交战。战斗没有分出胜负，双方随后都撤离。

en.s: The Battle of Mauchline Muir was an engagement fought on 12 June 1648 between two rival factions of the Covenanters of Scotland. On one side were those who favoured The Engagement, known as Engagers, and on the other those who were opposed to the Engagement, and known as the Kirk party.

zh.s: 莫赫莱恩荒原战役于1648年6月12日发生，是苏格兰圣约派两个对立阵营之间的一场战斗。一方支持《誓约》，称为“拥誓派”；另一方反对《誓约》，称为“教会派”。

en.t: Thomas Willett named first mayor under New York's English charter
en.s: On June 12, 1665, by the Old Style calendar then used in English New York, Governor Richard Nicolls issued a proclamation establishing a mayor, aldermen and sheriff for the city and named Thomas Willett mayor for a one-year term. Willett and the other officials took their oaths on June 14. The city had previously had Dutch burgomasters, so Willett is traditionally called its first mayor under English rule.
en.n: June 12, 1665 is the date in the contemporary Old Style (Julian) calendar; it corresponds to June 22 in the Gregorian calendar. The appointment proclamation came before the officials' June 14 oaths.

zh.t: 托马斯·威利特获任英治时期纽约首任市长
zh.s: 1665年6月12日，按当时纽约使用的旧历，英国总督理查德·尼科尔斯发布公告，为纽约设立市长、市议员和治安官等职位，并任命托马斯·威利特担任一年市长。威利特等人于6月14日宣誓就职。此前，纽约在荷兰统治下已有市政官员；威利特通常被称为英治时期的首任市长。
zh.n: 1665年旧历6月12日相当于公历6月22日。当天是任命公告发布的日子，官员们到6月14日才宣誓。

en.s: The Battle of Tolhuis or Crossing of the Rhine took place on 12 June 1672 during the Franco-Dutch War. The battle was fought between the army of Dutch Republic and the army of the French king Louis XIV.

zh.s: 托尔胡斯战役又称渡过莱茵河之战，于1672年6月12日在法荷战争期间发生。交战双方是荷兰共和国军队和法国国王路易十四的军队。

en.s: The Battle of Jao Modo (Mongolian: Зуунмод-Тэрэлжийн тулалдаан; Chinese: 昭莫多之战; pinyin: zhāo mò duō zhī zhàn) also known as the Battle of Zuunmod (literally "Battle of the Hundred Trees"), was fought on June 12, 1696 on the banks of the upper Terelj river 60 kilometres (37 mi) east of the modern-day Mongolian capital Ulaanbaatar. A Dzungar-Mongol army under the command of Galdan Boshugtu Khan was defeated by Qing armies personally led by the Kangxi Emperor. This decisive Qing victory in the early stages of the Dzungar–Qing Wars (1687–1758) effectively incorporated Khalkha Mongolia under Qing rule and relegated Dzungar Mongol forces to Inner Asia until they were finally defeated in 1758.

zh.t: 昭莫多（佐乌恩莫德）之战
zh.s: 昭莫多之战（蒙古语：Зуунмод-Тэрэлжийн тулалдаан；中文：昭莫多之战；拼音：zhāo mò duō zhī zhàn）又称佐乌恩莫德之战，发生于1696年6月12日，战场位于特列尔吉河上游岸边，距今蒙古首都乌兰巴托以东60公里。噶尔丹博硕克图汗率领的准噶尔蒙古军被康熙皇帝亲自统率的清军击败。这场清军的决定性胜利发生在准噶尔—清朝战争（1687–1758）初期，实际上使喀尔喀蒙古并入清朝统治，并将准噶尔蒙古势力限制在内亚，直至1758年最终被击败。

en.s: The Battle of Rheinberg took place on 12 June 1758 in Rheinberg, Germany during the Seven Years' War. A French force under the command of Comte de Clermont and an Anglo-German force under the command of the Duke of Brunswick fought a largely indecisive battle. It was a precursor to the more decisive Battle of Krefeld nine days later.

zh.s: 七年战争期间，莱茵贝格战役于1758年6月12日在德国莱茵贝格发生。克莱蒙伯爵率领的法军与不伦瑞克公爵率领的英德联军交战，战斗基本未分胜负。这场战斗是九天后更具决定性的克雷费尔德战役的前奏。

en.s: The raid on St Malo took place in June 1758 when an amphibious British naval expedition landed close to the French port of Saint-Malo in Brittany. While the town itself was not attacked, as had been initially planned, the British destroyed large amounts of shipping before re-embarking a week later. The naval forces were under the command of Richard Howe while the army was led by the Duke of Marlborough and Lord Sackville.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1758年6月，英国海军组织两栖远征队，在法国布列塔尼的圣马洛港附近登陆。英军原计划攻城，后来未进攻圣马洛本城，但摧毁了大量船只，一周后重新登船撤离。海军由理查德·豪指挥，陆军由马尔伯勒公爵和萨克维尔勋爵率领。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Virginia Declaration of Rights was drafted in 1776 to proclaim the inherent rights of men, including the right to reform or abolish "inadequate" government. It influenced a number of later documents, including the United States Declaration of Independence (1776) and the United States Bill of Rights (1789).
en.n: The Virginia Declaration of Rights is adopted.

zh.s: 《弗吉尼亚权利宣言》于1776年起草，旨在宣示人们与生俱来的权利，包括改革或废除“不适当”政府的权利。它影响了多份后来的文件，包括《美国独立宣言》（1776年）和《美国权利法案》（1789年）。
zh.n: 弗吉尼亚州宪法大会于1776年6月12日通过《弗吉尼亚权利宣言》。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Virginia on June 12, 1781. The delegate from York County Thomas Nelson Jr. was elected. The incumbent governor of Virginia Thomas Jefferson declined to seek re-election. Jefferson's constitutional term ended on June 2, the date the election of his successor was scheduled to take place. The normal election proceedings were disrupted by the Yorktown campaign, however, and the Virginia General Assembly was forced to flee Richmond to evade the advancing British forces.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于1781年6月12日举行州长选举，约克县代表托马斯·纳尔逊二世当选。时任州长托马斯·杰斐逊拒绝竞选连任。他的宪法规定任期于6月2日届满，原定当天选出继任者；但约克镇战役打乱了通常的选举程序，弗吉尼亚州议会被迫逃离里士满，以躲避向前推进的英军。

en.s: Following the unanimous declaration of the various district assemblies of Avignon on 12 June 1790, to secede from the Papal States and unite with France, war broke out between the municipal government of Avignon and the more conservative Comtat Venaissin, the larger county (comtat) which co-existed with Avignon and still pledged loyalty to the Papal States.

zh.t: 阿维尼翁—沃奈桑伯爵领战争
zh.s: 1790年6月12日，阿维尼翁各区议会一致宣布脱离教皇国并与法国合并。此后，阿维尼翁市政府与更保守的沃奈桑伯爵领之间爆发战争。该伯爵领与阿维尼翁相邻并共存，仍宣誓效忠教皇国。

en.s: The First Battle of Saorgio (8–12 June 1793) saw a French army commanded by Gaspard Jean-Baptiste Brunet attack the armies of the Sardinia-Piedmont and Austria led by Joseph Nikolaus De Vins. The local Sardinian commander in the Maritime Alps was Charles-François Thaon, Count of Saint-André. Though the French were initially successful in this War of the First Coalition action, their main assaults against the strong defensive positions on the Massif de l'Authion and the Col de Raus failed with serious losses.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次索尔吉奥战役发生于1793年6月8日至12日。第一次反法同盟战争期间，加斯帕尔·让-巴蒂斯特·布吕内指挥的法军进攻约瑟夫·尼古拉斯·德·万斯率领的撒丁—皮埃蒙特和奥地利军队。当地撒丁军队在滨海阿尔卑斯地区由圣安德烈伯爵夏尔-弗朗索瓦·泰翁指挥。法军起初一度占上风，但对奥蒂永山块和劳斯山口坚固阵地发起的主要进攻均告失败，造成重大损失。
zh.n: 本条记录的是来源资料框所列事件的结束日期。

en.t: Government forces occupy Ballynahinch and bombard rebel positions
en.s: On June 12, 1798, during the Irish rebellion, British commander George Nugent advanced on Ballynahinch, in today's Northern Ireland. His troops took a rebel outpost, occupied the town and began shelling the rebel positions at Montalto and Ednavady Hill that evening. Henry Munro's rebels attacked the next morning, when the main battle ended in a government victory.
en.n: June 12 marks Nugent's advance and bombardment; the main rebel assault followed on June 13.

zh.t: 政府军进占巴利纳欣奇并炮击起义军阵地
zh.s: 1798年6月12日，爱尔兰起义期间，乔治·纽金特率领政府军推进到今北爱尔兰的巴利纳欣奇。他们攻下起义军一处前哨，进入镇内，当晚炮击蒙塔尔托和埃德纳瓦迪山的起义军阵地。亨利·门罗率领的起义军次日反攻，战役最终以政府军获胜告终。
zh.n: 6月12日发生的是政府军进镇和炮击；起义军的主要进攻在6月13日。

en.s: The French First Republic, led by Napoleon Bonaparte, successfully invaded the islands of Malta and Gozo, then ruled by the Knights Hospitaller, in June 1798 as part of the Mediterranean campaign of the French Revolutionary Wars. The initial landings were met with some resistance from both the Order and the Maltese militia, but in less than a day the French had taken control of the entire Maltese archipelago except for the well-fortified harbour area that included the capital Valletta.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1798年6月，拿破仑·波拿巴率领法兰西第一共和国军队，在法国大革命战争的地中海战役中入侵并占领当时由医院骑士团统治的马耳他和戈佐岛。登陆初期遭到骑士团与马耳他民兵的抵抗，但不到一天，法军便控制除首都瓦莱塔所在坚固港区以外的整个群岛。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Modena (12 June 1799) saw a Republican French army commanded by Jacques MacDonald attack a Habsburg Austrian covering force led by Prince Friedrich Franz Xaver of Hohenzollern-Hechingen. The outnumbered Austrians were defeated but in an accidental encounter, MacDonald was painfully wounded by two saber cuts. The action occurred during the War of the Second Coalition, part of a larger conflict known as the French Revolutionary Wars. Modena is a city in northern Italy about 40 kilometres (25 mi) northwest of Bologna. In the battles of Magnano and Cassano, the Austrians and allied Russian Empire forces swept the French from much of northern Italy in April 1799.

zh.s: 摩德纳战役发生于1799年6月12日。雅克·麦克唐纳指挥的共和派法军进攻由霍亨索伦-黑兴根亲王弗里德里希·弗朗茨·克萨韦尔率领的哈布斯堡奥军掩护部队。寡不敌众的奥军被击败，但麦克唐纳在一次意外遭遇中被军刀砍伤两次，伤势严重。这场战斗发生在第二次反法同盟战争期间；该战争是更广泛的法国大革命战争的一部分。摩德纳是意大利北部的一座城市，位于博洛尼亚西北约40公里处。1799年4月，奥军和盟军俄罗斯帝国部队在马尼亚诺和卡萨诺战役中将法军逐出意大利北部大部分地区。

en.s: On the night of June 12, 1805, William Eaton's American-led force secretly evacuated Derna, in present-day Libya, after learning that the United States had reached peace with Tripoli. The troops had captured Derna in April and had held it against counterattacks. Eaton's men staged preparations for another attack to conceal their departure, then withdrew by boat.
en.n: June 12 is the Derna garrison's secret evacuation date, not the date the city was first captured or the peace treaty signed.

zh.t: 美军率领的部队秘密撤离德尔纳
zh.s: 1805年6月12日夜间，威廉·伊顿率领的部队得知美国已与的黎波里议和，便秘密撤出德尔纳，乘船离开。这支部队4月攻占了这座位于今利比亚的城市，此后数次守住阵地。撤离前，他们佯装准备再次进攻，以掩护行动。
zh.n: 6月12日是德尔纳守军秘密撤离的日期；攻占德尔纳和签订和约发生在此前。

loc: 西班牙卡韦松-德-皮苏埃加

en.s: The Battle of Cabezón was an engagement early in the Peninsular War on 12 June 1808 between a small Spanish militia force (grandiloquently styled the "Army of Castile"), based in Valladolid, and a detachment of Marshal Bessières' French Army Corps under General Lasalle. The battle took place when General Cuesta's small army, scraped together almost from scratch to defend Old Castile, deployed itself at the bridge over the Pisuerga at Cabezón, just 13 kilometres (8.1 mi) outside Valladolid, to bar the road from Burgos against oncoming French divisions.

zh.s: 卡韦松战役发生于1808年6月12日，是半岛战争初期的一场战斗。驻扎在巴利亚多利德、规模不大的西班牙民兵部队（夸称自己为“卡斯蒂利亚军团”）与贝西埃元帅法军中的一支分遣队交战，后者由拉萨尔将军率领。为了阻挡法军师从布尔戈斯方向推进，奎斯塔将军临时拼凑的小部队部署在卡韦松皮苏埃加河桥上，距巴利亚多利德仅13公里。

en.s: The Battle of Sopachuy was an armed confrontation that occurred on 12 June 1817 in the village of Sopachuy, some 120 kilometers southeast from the city of Chuquisaca (today Sucre), between a division of the Army of the North of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata, commanded by Lieutenant Colonel Gregorio Aráoz de Lamadrid and a Spanish Royalist force commanded by Colonel José Santos de la Hera.

zh.s: 索帕丘伊战役于1817年6月12日在索帕丘伊村发生，村庄位于丘基萨卡（今苏克雷）东南约120公里处。交战双方是拉普拉塔联合省北方军的一个师，由格雷戈里奥·阿劳斯·德拉马德里中校指挥；以及何塞·桑托斯·德拉埃拉上校指挥的西班牙保王军。

en.s: The Battle of Karlóca (now Sremski Karlovci, in the South Bačka District of the autonomous province of Vojvodina, Serbia) was the first battle in the Hungarian War of Independence of 1848-1849, fought on 12 June 1848 between the Hungarian Royal Army under the command of Lieutenant-General János Hrabovszky and Major Maximilian Eugen von Stein against the Serbian insurgents led by Lieutenant Đorđe Stratimirović.

zh.s: 卡尔洛瓦茨战役发生在1848至1849年匈牙利独立战争初期，是这场战争的第一场战役。战斗于1848年6月12日在卡尔洛瓦茨（今塞尔维亚伏伊伏丁那自治省南巴奇卡地区斯雷姆斯基卡尔洛夫奇）发生。交战双方是雅诺什·赫拉博夫斯基中将和马克西米利安·欧根·冯·施泰因少校指挥的匈牙利王家军，以及乔尔杰·斯特拉蒂米罗维奇中尉率领的塞尔维亚起义军。

en.s: The Battle of Cold Harbor was fought during the American Civil War near Mechanicsville, Virginia, from May 31 to June 12, 1864, with the most significant fighting occurring on June 3. It was one of the final battles of Union Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's Overland Campaign. Thousands of Union soldiers were killed or wounded in the frontal assault of June 3 against the fortified positions of Confederate Gen.
en.n: American Civil War, Overland Campaign: Battle of Cold Harbor: Ulysses S. Grant gives the Confederate forces under Robert E. Lee a victory when he pulls his Union troops from their position at Cold Harbor, Virginia and moves south.

zh.s: 美国内战期间，冷港之战于1864年5月31日至6月12日在弗吉尼亚州梅卡尼克斯维尔附近展开，最激烈的战斗发生在6月3日。这是联邦军尤利西斯·S.格兰特中将“陆路战役”的最后几场战斗之一。6月3日，联邦军正面进攻罗伯特·E.李将军构筑防线的邦联阵地，数千名士兵死伤。
zh.n: 美国内战陆路战役：格兰特将联邦军从弗吉尼亚州冷港阵地撤出，转向南方，邦联军队取得这场战斗的胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Trevilian Station (also called Trevilians) was fought on June 11–12, 1864, in Union Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's Overland Campaign against Confederate Gen. Robert E. Lee's Army of Northern Virginia. Union cavalry under Maj. Gen. Philip Sheridan fought against Confederate cavalry under Maj. Gens. Wade Hampton and Fitzhugh Lee in the bloodiest and largest all-cavalry battle of the war.

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 12 June 1866. In the elections for the Chamber of Representatives the result was a victory for the Liberal Party, which won 70 of the 122 seats. Voter turnout was 70%, although only 51,465 people were eligible to vote. Under the alternating system, elections were only held in five out of the nine provinces: Antwerp, Brabant, Luxembourg, Namur and West Flanders. Special elections were held in the arrondissements of Antwerp, Brussels and Leuven.

zh.s: 比利时于1866年6月12日举行部分大选。在众议院选举中，自由党获胜，赢得122个席位中的70席。投票率为70%，但只有51,465人符合投票资格。按照轮替制度，选举只在九个省中的五个省举行：安特卫普省、布拉班特省、卢森堡省、那慕尔省和西佛兰德省。安特卫普、布鲁塞尔和鲁汶选区另行举行了特别选举。

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 12 June 1888. The result was a victory for the Catholic Party, which won 98 of the 138 seats in the Chamber of Representatives and 47 of the 69 seats in the Senate. Under the alternating system, elections were held in only five out of the nine provinces: Antwerp, Brabant, Luxembourg, Namur and West Flanders.

en.s: The Philippine Declaration of Independence (Filipino: Pagpapahayag ng Kasarinlan ng Pilipinas) was proclaimed on June 12, 1898 in Cavite II el Viejo (present-day Kawit, Cavite), Philippines. With the public reading of the Act of the Declaration of independence (Spanish: Acta de la proclamación de independencia del pueblo Filipino; Filipino: Paggawa ng Proklamasyon ng Kasarinlan ng sambayanang Pilipino), Filipino revolutionary forces under General Emilio Aguinaldo proclaimed the sovereignty and independence of the Philippine Islands from the colonial rule of Spain.

zh.s: 菲律宾独立宣言（菲律宾语：Pagpapahayag ng Kasarinlan ng Pilipinas）于1898年6月12日在菲律宾甲米地省旧卡维特（今卡维特）宣布。埃米利奥·阿吉纳尔多将军率领的菲律宾革命军公开宣读《菲律宾人民独立宣言法案》（西班牙语：Acta de la proclamación de independencia del pueblo Filipino；菲律宾语：Paggawa ng Proklamasyon ng Kasarinlan ng sambayanang Pilipino），宣布菲律宾群岛摆脱西班牙殖民统治，成为主权独立国家。

en.s: The 1899 New Richmond tornado was an estimated F5 tornado that formed in the early evening of Monday, June 12, 1899, leaving a 45-mile-long (72 km) path of destruction through St. Croix, Polk, and Barron counties in west-central Wisconsin. There were a total of 117 fatalities and 150 injuries, with hundreds more reported as displaced. The worst devastation occurred in the city of New Richmond, which took a direct hit from the storm.

zh.s: 1899年新里士满龙卷风估计达到F5级，于1899年6月12日星期一傍晚形成。龙卷风在威斯康星州中西部的圣克罗伊、波尔克和巴伦县留下长达45英里（72公里）的破坏路径。事故共造成117人死亡、150人受伤，另有数百人流离失所。新里士满市遭龙卷风正面袭击，破坏最为严重。

en.s: The massacre of Phocaea (Greek: Η Σφαγή της Φώκαιας, romanized: I Sfagí tis Fókaias; Turkish: Foça Katliamı) occurred in June 1914, as part of the ethnic cleansing policies of the Ottoman Empire that included exile, massacre and deportations. It was perpetrated by irregular Turkish bands against the predominantly ethnic Greek town of Phocaea, modern Foça, on the east coast of the Aegean Sea.
en.n: Massacre of Phocaea: Turkish irregulars slaughter 50 to 100 Greeks and expel thousands of others in an ethnic cleansing operation in the Ottoman Empire.

zh.n: 福西亚大屠杀：土耳其非正规武装杀害约50至100名希腊族人，并驱逐数千人。

en.t: Soviet command orders poison gas against Tambov rebels
en.s: On June 12, 1921, Soviet commanders issued an order authorizing poison gas against rebels hiding in forests during the Tambov uprising. The order did not end the rebellion that day; fighting continued into 1922.

en.t: 3rd National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
en.s: The 3rd National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party was held in Guangzhou at 31 Xuguyuan Road between 12 June and 20 June 1923. It succeeded the 2nd National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party and preceded the 4th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party. The congress was attended by 40 representatives across China and Moscow representing 420 party members of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP).

en.s: The 1927 Campeonato de Portugal Final was the final match of the 1926–27 Campeonato de Portugal, the 6th season of the Campeonato de Portugal, the Portuguese football knockout tournament, organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 12 June 1927 at the Estádio do Lumiar in Lisbon, and opposed Belenenses and Vitória de Setúbal. Belenenses defeated Vitória de Setúbal 3–0 to claim their first Campeonato de Portugal.

en.s: In the 1929 South African general election, held on 12 June 1929, the National Party under James Barry Munnik Hertzog won an outright majority in the House of Assembly. Hertzog had the opportunity to form a government without the aid of the Labour Party. In fact the Pact government continued, with two ministers from the Creswell Labour faction remaining in office. The National Party remained the dominant party, for its second consecutive term. Due to the split in the Labour Party, just eight MPs were elected for the party, of whom only four sat on the government benches.

zh.s: 1929年6月12日举行的南非大选中，詹姆斯·巴里·穆尼克·赫佐格领导的国民党在众议院赢得绝对多数。赫佐格本可不依靠工党组建政府，但事实是，联盟政府继续执政，克雷斯韦尔工党派系的两名部长留任。国民党连续第二届保持主导地位。工党分裂后，该党只有8名议员当选，其中仅4人进入政府阵营。

en.s: The 1932 German football championship final decided the winner of the 1932 German football championship, the 25th of the German football championship, a knockout football cup competition contested by the regional league winners to determine the national champions. en.s: The Battle of Carentan was an engagement in World War II between airborne forces of the United States Army and the German Wehrmacht during the Battle of Normandy. The battle took place from 10 to 14 June 1944, on the approaches to and within the town of Carentan, France. The objective of the attacking American forces was consolidation of the U.S. beachheads (Utah Beach and Omaha Beach) and establishment of a continuous defensive line against expected German counterattacks.
en.n: World War II: Battle of Carentan: American paratroopers of the 101st Airborne Division secure the town of Carentan, Normandy, France.

zh.s: 卡朗唐战役是第二次世界大战期间的一场战斗，交战双方为美国陆军空降部队和德国国防军。战斗于1944年6月10日至14日在法国卡朗唐镇及其周边地区发生。美国进攻部队的目标是巩固犹他海滩和奥马哈海滩两个滩头阵地，并建立一条连续防线，以抵御预期中的德军反攻。

en.s: French legislative elections took place on June 5 and June 12, 1988, to elect the ninth National Assembly of the Fifth Republic, one month after the re-election of François Mitterrand as President of France. In 1986, the Socialist Party (PS) of President Mitterrand lost the legislative election. For the first time under the Fifth Republic, the President was forced to "cohabit" with a hostile parliamentary majority and cabinet. He chose the RPR leader Jacques Chirac as Prime Minister. The two heads of the executive power were rivals for the 1988 presidential election.

zh.s: 法国于1988年6月5日和12日举行国民议会选举，选出第五共和国第九届国民议会议员。选举距弗朗索瓦·密特朗连任法国总统一个月。1986年，密特朗领导的社会党在议会选举中失利。第五共和国成立后，总统首次不得不与立场敌对的议会多数派和内阁“左右共治”。密特朗任命保卫共和联盟领袖雅克·希拉克为总理，两位行政权力领导人随后在1988年总统选举中成为对手。

en.t: Russia Day: The parliament of the Russian Federation formally declares its sovereignty
en.s: Russia Day (Russian: День России, romanized: Den' Rossii), called Day of Adoption of the Declaration of State Sovereignty of RSFSR (Russian: День принятия Декларации о государственном суверенитете РСФСР, romanized: Den' prinyatia Declaratsii o gosudarstvennom suverenitete RSFSR) before 2002, is the national holiday of Russia. The result was a victory for Moshood Kashimawo Olawale Abiola of the Social Democratic Party, who defeated Bashir Tofa of the National Republican Convention. However, the elections were later annulled by military ruler Ibrahim Babangida, leading to a crisis that ended with Sani Abacha heading a coup later in the year.

zh.s: 尼日利亚于1993年6月12日举行总统选举，这是1983年军事政变以来的首次总统选举。社会民主党候选人莫舒德·卡希马沃·奥拉瓦莱·阿比奥拉获胜，击败全国共和大会候选人巴希尔·托法。然而，军事统治者易卜拉欣·巴班吉达后来宣布选举无效，引发一场危机；同年晚些时候，萨尼·阿巴查发动政变并掌权，危机随之结束。

en.s: The 1993 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1992–93 DFB-Pokal, the 50th season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 12 June 1993 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. Hertha BSC's second team, playing in the third division, made it to the final against Bayer Leverkusen, making it the first and only time a reserve side has made it to the final, as second teams have since been disallowed from entering the competition.

zh.s: 1993年德国足协杯决赛决出了1992–93赛季德国足协杯冠军，这是德国顶级淘汰制足球杯赛的第50个赛季。决赛于1993年6月12日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。德甲球队勒沃库森对阵来自第三级联赛的柏林赫塔二队。赫塔二队闯入决赛是赛事史上首次，也是迄今唯一一次预备队打入决赛；此后预备队不再被允许参加该赛事。

en.s: An election of MEP representing Portugal constituency for the 1994-1999 term of the European Parliament was held on 12 June 1994. It was part of the wider 1994 European election. In the closest nationwide election in Portuguese history, the Socialist Party (PS) polled just less than 0.5 percent ahead of the Social Democrats (PSD).

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1994年6月12日举行选举，选出代表葡萄牙选区、任期为1994至1999年的欧洲议会议员。这是1994年欧洲议会选举的一部分。在葡萄牙历史上全国范围内竞争最激烈的一次选举中，社会党（PS）的得票率仅比社会民主党（PSD）高不到0.5个百分点。

en.s: Elections to the European Parliament were held in Belgium on 12 June 1994. The Dutch-speaking electoral college elected 14 MEPs, the French-speaking electoral college elected 10 MEPs and the German-speaking electoral college elected 1 MEP.

en.s: An election was held in Spain on 12 June 1994 as part of the concurrent EU-wide election to the 4th European Parliament. All 64 seats allocated to the Spanish constituency as per the 1993 Council Decision amending the Direct Elections Act were up for election. It was held concurrently with a regional election in Andalusia.

zh.s: 西班牙于1994年6月12日举行选举，参与欧盟范围内同步进行的第四届欧洲议会选举。根据1993年修订《直接选举法》的理事会决定，分配给西班牙选区的64个席位全部改选。此次选举与安达卢西亚地区选举同时举行。

en.s: The 1994 European Parliament election in Luxembourg was the election of MEP representing Luxembourg constituency for the 1994–1999 term of the European Parliament. It was part of the wider 1994 European election. It was held on 12 June 1994.

zh.s: 卢森堡于1994年6月12日举行欧洲议会选举，选出代表卢森堡选区、任期为1994至1999年的欧洲议会议员。这是1994年欧洲议会选举的一部分。

en.s: European Parliament elections were held in Greece on 12 June 1994 to elect the 25 Greek members of the European Parliament. Members were elected by party-list proportional representation, with a 3% electoral threshold.

zh.s: 希腊于1994年6月12日举行欧洲议会选举，选出25名希腊籍欧洲议会议员。选举采用政党名单比例代表制，得票率须达到3%才能获得席位。

en.s: A regional election was held in Andalusia on 12 June 1994 to elect the 4th Parliament of the autonomous community. All 109 seats in the Parliament were up for election. It was held concurrently with the 1994 European Parliament election. The candidate for the PSOE, Manuel Chaves, was invested as President of the Regional Government of Andalusia after winning the election.

zh.s: 安达卢西亚于1994年6月12日举行自治区选举，选出自治区第四届议会全部109名议员。选举与1994年欧洲议会选举同时举行。社会工党候选人曼努埃尔·查韦斯胜出，并获任命为安达卢西亚自治区政府主席。

en.s: An election of the delegation from Germany to the European Parliament (EP) was held in June 1994. Due to the accession of the former East German states in 1990, these were the first EU elections in Germany to have East Germans voting. Additionally, the ratification of the 1992 Maastricht Treaty meant that for the first time, European Union citizens resident in Germany could vote on the German members of the European Parliament.

zh.s: 1994年欧洲议会选举中，德国选区于1994年6月举行投票。由于1990年东德各州并入德国，这是德国东部居民首次参加德国的欧盟选举。1992年《马斯特里赫特条约》获批准后，居住在德国的欧盟公民也首次有权投票选举德国的欧洲议会议员。
zh.n: 德国联邦选举事务主任资料记载，这次选举于1994年6月12日举行。

en.s: The 1994 European Parliamentary election was a European election held across the 12 European Union member states in June 1994. This election saw the merge of the European People's Party and European Democrats, an increase in the overall number of seats (567 members were elected to the European Parliament) and a fall in overall turnout to 57%.

zh.s: 1994年欧洲议会选举于1994年6月在12个欧盟成员国举行。此次选举中，欧洲人民党与欧洲民主党合并，议会议席总数增加至567席，投票率降至57%。

en.s: General elections were held in Dominica on 12 June 1995. Although the Dominica Freedom Party received the most votes, the United Workers' Party won 11 of the 21 seats. Voter turnout was 65.2%, the lowest since universal suffrage was introduced in 1951.

zh.s: 多米尼克于1995年6月12日举行大选。尽管多米尼克自由党得票最多，联合工人党仍赢得21个席位中的11席。投票率为65.2%，是1951年实行普选以来最低的一次。

en.s: Snap general elections were held in Bangladesh on 12 June 1996. They were called following the controversial February 1996 elections, which were boycotted by the opposition and saw a turnout of just 21%. The result of the snap elections was a victory for the Bangladesh Awami League, which won 146 of the 300 directly elected seats, resulting in its leader Sheikh Hasina becoming Prime Minister.

zh.s: 孟加拉国于1996年6月12日提前举行大选。此前，1996年2月举行的选举因受到反对党抵制而引发争议，投票率仅为21%，新一轮选举因此提前举行。人民联盟获胜，赢得直接选举的300个席位中的146席，其领导人谢赫·哈西娜随后出任总理。

en.s: The 1999 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1998–99 DFB-Pokal, the 56th season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 12 June 1999 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. Werder Bremen won the match 5–4 on penalties against Bayern Munich, following a 1–1 draw after extra time, to claim their 4th cup title.

zh.s: 1999年德国足协杯决赛决出了1998–99赛季德国足协杯冠军，这是德国顶级淘汰制足球杯赛的第56个赛季。决赛于1999年6月12日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。云达不来梅在加时赛1比1战平拜仁慕尼黑后，于点球大战中以5比4获胜，第四次夺得杯赛冠军。

en.s: The 2003 Algerian Cup final was the 39th final of the Algerian Cup. The final took place on June 12, 2003, at Stade Mustapha Tchaker in Blida with kick-off at 15:00. USM Alger beat CR Belouizdad in extra time with a golden goal in the 117th minute in the final after the game ended 1–1. It was USM Alger's sixth Algerian Cup in its history.

zh.s: 2003年阿尔及利亚杯决赛是该项赛事的第39场决赛，于2003年6月12日在布利达的穆斯塔法·查克尔体育场举行，15:00开球。阿尔及尔联合队与贝鲁兹达德青年队在常规时间1比1战平，随后阿尔及尔联合队在加时赛第117分钟以金球制获胜。这是该队队史第六次夺得阿尔及利亚杯。

en.s: An election of Members of the European Parliament representing Malta constituency for the 2004–2009 term was held on 12 June 2004 as part of the wider 2004 European election. The election used Single Transferable Vote. The opposition Malta Labour Party polled strongly. The Malta Labour Party has won every European parliament election since, as of 2024.

zh.s: 马耳他于2004年6月12日举行欧洲议会选举，选出2004至2009年任期的马耳他选区欧洲议会议员。选举采用单记可让渡投票制。反对党工党取得明显优势。截至2024年，工党在此后的每次欧洲议会选举中都获胜。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The election of MEPs representing Latvia constituency for the 2004–2009 term of the European Parliament was held on 12 June 2004. It was the first European Parliament election in Latvia following its admission to the European Union in May 2004. It was part of the wider 2004 European election. There were lists of candidates from 16 political parties. with a total of 1019 candidates.

zh.s: 拉脱维亚于2004年6月12日举行欧洲议会选举，选出代表拉脱维亚选区、任期为2004至2009年的欧洲议会议员。这是拉脱维亚于2004年5月加入欧盟后首次举行欧洲议会选举，也是2004年欧洲议会选举的一部分。共有16个政党提交候选人名单，候选人总数为1,019人。

en.t: 2004 European Parliament election in the Czech Republic
en.s: The 2004 European Parliament election in the Czech Republic was the election of members of the European Parliament (MEPs) representing the Czech Republic for the 2004–2009 term of the European Parliament. It was part of the wider 2004 European election. These were the first European elections after the country's EU accession and hence the first to be held in the Czech Republic. They took place on 11 and 12 June 2004.

zh.s: 2004年捷克欧洲议会选举选出代表捷克、任期为2004至2009年的欧洲议会议员，是2004年欧洲议会选举的一部分。这是捷克加入欧盟后举行的首次欧洲议会选举，也是该国第一次举行此类选举。投票于2004年6月11日至12日进行。

en.s: ECW One Night Stand (2005) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). Presented by THQ's Destroy All Humans!, it was held on June 12, 2005, at the Hammerstein Ballroom in New York, New York. The main event was a tag team match between The Dudley Boyz (Buh Buh Ray and D-Von Dudley) and the team of Tommy Dreamer and The Sandman. Two of the matches on the undercard were Chris Benoit versus Eddie Guerrero, and Mike Awesome versus Masato Tanaka.

zh.s: ECW《一夜摊牌》（2005年）是一场由世界摔角娱乐（WWE）制作、THQ游戏《全面毁灭》的赞助赛事，于2005年6月12日在纽约市哈默斯坦舞厅举行。主赛是双打比赛：杜德利兄弟（布布·雷和德文·杜德利）对阵汤米·梦想家和桑德曼。副赛中两场比赛分别是克里斯·班瓦对阵埃迪·格雷罗，以及迈克·奥瑟姆对阵田中政人。

en.s: UFC Fight Night: Stout vs. Fisher (also known as UFC Fight Night 10) was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship on Tuesday, June 12, 2007 at the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino in Hollywood, Florida.

zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：斯托特对阵费舍尔（又称UFC格斗之夜10）是一场由终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）主办的综合格斗赛事，于2007年6月12日星期二在佛罗里达州好莱坞的塞米诺尔硬石酒店与赌场举行。

en.s: A leadership election was held by the Israeli Labor Party on 12 June 2007, to elect the party's new leader, due to internal dissatisfaction with the incumbent chairman Amir Peretz. The winner was Ehud Barak.

zh.s: 以色列工党于2007年6月12日举行党魁选举，选出新任党魁。此次选举源于党内对时任主席阿米尔·佩雷茨的不满，埃胡德·巴拉克胜出。

en.t: 2009 Assembly of Experts by-election in Tehran province
en.s: A by-election was held on 12 June 2009 for the vacant seat of the Assembly of Experts in Tehran Province, caused by death of Mohammad-Hassan Marashi. It was held along with the 2009 Iranian presidential election. The seat was won by Mahmoud Alavi, who gained more than 2.6 millions out of 5.8 millions of votes cast. He was not supported by major clerical organizations, The Two Societies had endorsed Mohammad-Ali Taskhiri.

zh.s: 德黑兰省专家会议席位空缺后，于2009年6月12日举行补选。空缺由穆罕默德-哈桑·马拉希去世造成。补选与2009年伊朗总统选举同时举行。马哈茂德·阿拉维赢得该席位，在580多万张选票中获得超过260万票。主要宗教机构没有支持他，“两大宗教团体”则支持穆罕默德-阿里·塔什基里。

en.s: The 2009 Sobat River ambush was a battle between Jikany Nuer tribesmen and the Sudanese People's Liberation Army (SPLA), which was escorting a United Nations (UN) aid convoy, on 12 June 2009.

zh.s: 2009年索巴特河伏击战于2009年6月12日发生，交战双方是吉卡尼努尔族武装和护送联合国救援车队的苏丹人民解放军（SPLA）。

en.s: A parliamentary election took place in Slovakia on 12 June 2010. The elections were contested by eighteen parties, six of which passed the 5% threshold for sitting in parliament. Despite the incumbent Smer of Prime Minister Robert Fico winning a plurality, the new government consisted of a coalition led by the Slovak Democratic and Christian Union – Democratic Party's Iveta Radičová and included KDH, SaS and Most-Hid. However, her government fell on 11 October 2011 following a vote of no confidence with a new election called for 10 March 2012.

zh.s: 斯洛伐克于2010年6月12日举行议会选举，共有18个政党参选，其中6个政党超过5%的议席门槛。总理罗伯特·菲佐领导的执政党方向党虽然赢得最多选票，但新政府由斯洛伐克民主与基督教联盟—民主党领袖伊维塔·拉迪乔娃领导的联合政府组成，成员还包括基督教民主运动、自由与团结党和桥党。2011年10月11日，她的政府在不信任投票后倒台，并宣布于2012年3月10日重新举行选举。

en.s: Slammiversary IX was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA), which took place on June 12, 2011 at the Impact Wrestling Zone in Orlando, Florida. It was the seventh Slammiversary event and celebrated the ninth anniversary of TNA Wrestling.

zh.s: Slammiversary IX是一场由全不间断动作摔角（TNA）制作的职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2011年6月12日在佛罗里达州奥兰多的Impact摔角区举行。这是第七届Slammiversary赛事，也是TNA摔角成立九周年纪念活动。

en.s: General elections were held in Turkey on 12 June 2011 to elect the 550 members of Grand National Assembly. In accordance to the result of the constitutional referendum held in 2007, the elections were held four years after the previous elections in 2007 instead of five.

zh.s: 土耳其于2011年6月12日举行大选，选出大国民议会的550名议员。根据2007年宪法公投结果，本次选举在上届2007年大选四年后举行，而不是五年后。

en.s: The Zawiya skirmish began on 11 June 2011, when the National Liberation Army launched an attack into the coastal city of Zawiya, Libya in an attempt to recapture it from army units and militiamen loyal to Muammar Gaddafi. The attack was quickly crushed by the numerically superior and better-equipped loyalist forces, who had taken the city earlier in the Libyan Civil War after defeating rebel forces in a major battle that lasted from February to March 2011.

zh.s: 2011年6月11日，利比亚民族解放军攻入海滨城市扎维耶，试图从效忠穆阿迈尔·卡扎菲的军队和民兵手中夺回该城。忠于卡扎菲的部队人数更多、装备更好，很快击退进攻；他们此前已在2月至3月的一场大战中夺取扎维耶。

en.s: In June 2011, during the civil uprising phase of the Syrian Civil War, rebels seized the city of Jisr ash-Shughur, resulting in violent clashes with the Syrian security forces, including the military. en.s: The Cyrenaican desert campaign was a military campaign that initiated in April 2011 by the Libyan military in the form of hit-and-run attacks against rebel-held towns and oil facilities in the eastern Libyan Desert, during the Libyan Civil War. The campaign failed in denying anti-Gaddafi forces control of southern Cyrenaica.

en.s: The 2012 Ivorian coup attempt was a failed coup d'état by exiled military officers loyal to former president Laurent Gbagbo to overthrow President Alassane Ouattara's administration in the Ivory Coast. State security seized documents that outlined plans for the eventual overthrow and replacement of the democratically elected leader with a transitional military council.

zh.s: 2012年，流亡海外、效忠前总统洛朗·巴博的军官试图推翻科特迪瓦总统阿拉萨内·瓦塔拉政府，但政变失败。国家安全部门查获文件，显示他们计划推翻民选总统，另设过渡军事委员会。

en.s: The first edition of the Champs-Élysées Film Festival was held from 6 to 12 June 2012, with actors Lambert Wilson and Michael Madsen presiding. During the first edition, more than 15,000 people attended, with more than 50 films screened. Besides the Official Selection of American Independent Films, the Festival's main event, three other non-competitive selections were presented: French Galas, American Galas and Oscar Nominated Foreign Language Films.

zh.s: 首届香榭丽舍电影节于2012年6月6日至12日举行，由演员朗贝尔·威尔逊和迈克尔·马德森担任主席。首届电影节吸引超过15,000人参加，放映50多部影片。除作为电影节主要活动的美国独立电影官方竞赛单元外，还设有三个非竞赛单元：法国影片展映、美国影片展映和奥斯卡提名外语片展映。

en.s: A 2012 special election in Arizona's 8th congressional district was held on June 12, with primary elections held on April 17, to fill a seat in the United States House of Representatives for Arizona's 8th congressional district until the 112th United States Congress ends on January 3, 2013. The election was caused by the resignation of Representative Gabby Giffords on January 25, 2012, to concentrate on recovering from her injuries from the 2011 Tucson shooting.

zh.t: 2012年亚利桑那州第八国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 亚利桑那州第八国会选区于2012年6月12日举行特别选举，4月17日先举行初选，以填补美国众议院第112届国会结束前的空缺席位；该任期于2013年1月3日结束。加比·吉福兹众议员于2012年1月25日辞职，以专心从2011年图森枪击案所受伤势中康复，因此触发了这次选举。

en.s: On 12 June 2014, the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIS) killed at least 1,566 Shia Iraqi Air Force cadets in an attack on Camp Speicher in Tikrit. At the time of the attack there were between 4,000 and 11,000 unarmed cadets in the camp. Alleged ISIS fighters singled out Shia and non-Muslim cadets from Sunni ones and murdered them. The Iraqi government blamed the massacre on both ISIS and members from the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party – Iraq Region.

zh.s: 2014年6月12日，伊拉克和黎凡特伊斯兰国（ISIS）袭击提克里特的斯佩彻营，杀害至少1,566名什叶派伊拉克空军学员。袭击发生时，营内有4,000至11,000名没有武装的学员。据称，ISIS武装人员从逊尼派学员中挑出什叶派和非穆斯林学员并将其杀害。伊拉克政府将屠杀归咎于ISIS和阿拉伯复兴社会党伊拉克地区组织成员。

en.s: General elections were held in Ontario, Canada on June 12, 2014, to elect the members of the 41st Parliament of Ontario. The Liberal Party won a majority of seats in the legislature, allowing its leader, Kathleen Wynne, to continue as premier, moving from a minority to majority government. This was the Liberals' fourth consecutive win since 2003 and an improvement from their performance in the 2011 election.

zh.s: 加拿大安大略省于2014年6月12日举行大选，选出安大略省第41届议会议员。自由党赢得议会多数，使其党魁凯瑟琳·韦恩得以继续担任省长，并将少数政府转为多数政府。这是自由党自2003年以来连续第四次获胜，成绩也好于2011年大选。

en.s: General elections were held in Antigua and Barbuda on 12 June 2014. The result was a victory for the opposition Antigua and Barbuda Labour Party led by Gaston Browne, which won 14 of the 17 seats. Following the election, Browne became the country's youngest Prime Minister.

en.s: On June 12, 2016, 29-year-old Omar Mateen shot and killed 49 people and wounded 58 in a mass shooting at Pulse, a gay nightclub in Orlando, Florida, United States. Pulse was hosting a "Latin Night", and most of the victims were of Latino descent. In a 911 call made shortly after the shooting began, Mateen swore allegiance to the leader of ISIS, Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi, and said the U.S. killing of Abu Waheeb in Iraq the previous month "triggered" the shooting.

zh.s: 2016年6月12日，29岁的奥马尔·马丁在美国佛罗里达州奥兰多的Pulse同志夜店开枪，造成49人死亡、58人受伤。事发时，Pulse正在举办“拉丁之夜”，大多数受害者有拉丁裔背景。枪击开始后不久，马丁拨打911并宣誓效忠伊斯兰国领导人阿布·贝克尔·巴格达迪，还称美国上月在伊拉克击杀阿布·瓦希卜一事“触发”了枪击。

en.s: The 2016 Slammiversary was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It took place on June 12 at the Impact Zone in Orlando, Florida. It was the twelfth event under the Slammiversary chronology and the first event in the 2016 TNA PPV schedule. It was the final Slammiversary event to be branded under the Total Nonstop Action Wrestling name — until 2024 — before it was changed to Impact Wrestling the following year.

zh.s: 2016年Slammiversary是一场由全不间断动作摔角（TNA）主办的职业摔角按次付费赛事，于6月12日在佛罗里达州奥兰多的Impact Zone举行。这是Slammiversary系列的第12场赛事，也是TNA 2016年按次付费赛程中的首场。直到2024年赛事品牌恢复使用Total Nonstop Action Wrestling名称之前，这是最后一场以该名称冠名的Slammiversary；次年名称改为Impact Wrestling。

en.s: The 2018 North Korea–United States Singapore Summit, commonly known as the Singapore Summit, was a summit meeting between North Korean leader Kim Jong Un and U.S. president Donald Trump, held at the Capella Hotel, Sentosa, Singapore, on June 12, 2018. en.t: Kassym-Jomart Tokayev is inaugurated as the second president of Kazakhstan
en.s: Kassym-Jomart Kemeluly Tokayev (born 17 May 1953) is a Kazakh politician and diplomat who has served as the second president of Kazakhstan since 2019. He previously served as Prime Minister from 1999 to 2002 and as Chairman of the Senate from 2007 to 2011 and again from 2013 to 2019. Tokayev also held the position of Director-General of the United Nations Office at Geneva from 2011 to 2013.

zh.t: 托卡耶夫宣誓就任哈萨克斯坦总统
zh.s: 卡西姆若马尔特·克梅列维奇·托卡耶夫（1953年5月17日生）是哈萨克斯坦政治家和外交官，自2019年起担任该国第二任总统。他此前曾于1999年至2002年担任总理，2007年至2011年以及2013年至2019年担任参议院议长，并于2011年至2013年担任联合国日内瓦办事处总干事。
zh.n: 托卡耶夫于2019年6月12日宣誓并正式就任哈萨克斯坦总统。

en.s: On 12 June 2024, an early-morning fire broke out at a residential building in Mangaf in Kuwait's Ahmadi Governorate housing 196 male migrant workers of NBTC Group, killing 50 migrant workers, at least 46 of whom were from India, and injuring around 50 others. Most victims died of smoke inhalation, while others were fatally injured from falling. The building's owner was arrested in the wake of the fire.

en.s: Air India Flight 171 was a scheduled international passenger flight from Ahmedabad Airport, Gujarat, India, to London Gatwick Airport in Crawley, West Sussex, England. On 12 June 2025, at 13:39 IST (08:09 UTC), the Boeing 787-8 Dreamliner operating the flight crashed 32 seconds after takeoff into the student hostels of the Byramjee Jeejeebhoy Medical College, 1.7 kilometres (1 mi; 0.9 nmi) from the runway.

zh.s: 印度航空171号班机是一趟定期国际客运航班，从印度古吉拉特邦艾哈迈达巴德机场飞往英格兰西萨塞克斯郡克劳利的伦敦盖特威克机场。2025年6月12日印度标准时间13:39（协调世界时08:09），执飞的波音787-8“梦想客机”起飞32秒后坠毁，撞入拜拉姆吉·吉杰博伊医学院的学生宿舍，坠机地点距跑道1.7公里（1英里；0.9海里）。
